summary.text: Todd Buchwald is the Republican candidate for the Minnesota House of Representatives, District 55B, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Hunter Cantrell (D) for a seat with no incumbent.
He worked in insurance and, in a Ballotpedia survey, said he spent 22 years helping small businesses with health care plans before retiring in February 2026.

paragraphs.text: Todd Buchwald graduated from Ames High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Iowa State University in 2004.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he has lived in Minnesota for 32 years and in Burnsville, and that he received the Burnsville Community Builder Award in 2020.
He said his campaign messages are restoring integrity to the State House, demanding accountability and lowering taxes, and driving economic prosperity and job growth.
He advanced from the August 11, 2026 Republican primary with 100 percent of the 1,856 votes cast.
